body_es: Scrum define tres roles principales: el Scrum Master actúa como facilitador y coach, eliminando impedimentos y asegurando que el equipo siga las prácticas de Scrum; el Product Owner es responsable de maximizar el valor del producto, gestionando el backlog de producto y priorizando trabajo; y el Development Team son los profesionales que transforman los requisitos en increments de software funcional. Cada rol tiene responsabilidades claras y distintas que trabajan juntas para entregar valor de manera consistente. La claridad en estos roles es fundamental para que Scrum funcione efectivamente.
body_en: Scrum defines three main roles: the Scrum Master acts as facilitator and coach, removing impediments and ensuring the team follows Scrum practices; the Product Owner is responsible for maximizing product value, managing the product backlog and prioritizing work; and the Development Team are professionals who transform requirements into increments of functional software. Each role has clear and distinct responsibilities that work together to deliver value consistently. Clarity in these roles is fundamental for Scrum to function effectively.
example_code:
# Scrum Roles and Responsibilities (YAML)
scrum_roles:
  scrum_master:
    primary_focus: "Process and team enablement"
    responsibilities:
      - "Facilitate Scrum events"
      - "Remove impediments (blockers)"
      - "Protect team from interruptions"
      - "Coach team on Scrum practices"
    authority: "Moderate, focuses on process"
  
  product_owner:
    primary_focus: "Product value and requirements"
    responsibilities:
      - "Maintain product backlog"
      - "Prioritize features by business value"
      - "Define acceptance criteria"
      - "Communicate with stakeholders"
    authority: "High, owns product decisions"
  
  development_team:
    primary_focus: "Creating working software"
    responsibilities:
      - "Select work for sprint"
      - "Build and test features"
      - "Estimate effort"
      - "Self-organize work"
    authority: "High, owns technical decisions"
example_output:
Scrum Team Structure:
- Scrum Master: 1 person
- Product Owner: 1 person
- Development Team: 3-9 professionals
